runtime_changes: explicit agent and verifier bridge subnets only

methodology.model_calls: Proxy Responses requests only; exclude hook duplicates and parent WebSocket connections; separate generate=false warmup.
methodology.input: Disjoint ordinary input + cache read + cache write; repeated context is counted on each request.
methodology.native_input: Pi native input excludes cache writes; use the normalized disjoint bucket sum consistently for all three agents.
methodology.missing_usage: Requests without usage remain in the request count. Cost and token sums are lower bounds when coverage is incomplete.
methodology.hermes_native: Harbor reports zero tokens for this Hermes export; that is not zero consumption. The separate native session counters and observed proxy usage are retained.
methodology.hermes_auxiliary: The final request asks to review the conversation and update the skill library, after the native final stop reply. It has no captured usage and is not a task-solving round.
methodology.reasoning: Subset of output; never added twice.
methodology.time: Command launch through reap including recorder startup and flush; excludes installation, verifier and import.
methodology.verification: Official verifier reward is separate from recording integrity and independent transport audit.
methodology.local_overlay: Original task files byte-identical; only explicit agent and verifier Docker bridge subnets added.
methodology.control: Isolated official oracle reward=1 before trials; no solution or verifier hints supplied to agents.
methodology.scope: One independent attempt per agent; no automatic retries. Not a leaderboard submission or causal agent ranking.

qualification_recovery.action: Re-observe the same imported recording; no trial launch or re-import
qualification_recovery.cause: Initial check preceded the asynchronously generated verified proof

privacy: Aggregates, identifiers and hashes only. No captured payloads, solutions, prompts or credentials.
